text: Shard-count false positives: Atlas treats a replica set as having one shard. A minShardCount policy above 1 without a cluster-type check flags every replica set in scope as non-compliant, flooding the endpoint. Use minShardCount only for minimums and maxShardCount only for maximums, and add the !context.cluster.isConvertingToSharded exception for replica-set-to-sharded conversions. (high confidence)
